item.title: Patch Notes - Version 24.02
item.description:
Greetings,

The following page lists patch notes for all updates in this release (Version 24.02 AKA Fractured Skies). We invite you to join the player discussion about the content of this release on EVE Online forums:

  • General Feedback

  • Known Issues

Initial Release Date: 2026-11-10 Last update: 2026-11-18

🤝 - Indicates a change inspired by the player's feedback or suggestions.

Patch Notes for 2026-11-18.1

Features & Changes:

Balancing:

  • Increased the LP store costs of the 5-run Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier blueprint copies:

    • Amarr Navy stores: 270,000 LP + 375,000,000 ISK (from 110,000 LP + 150,000,000 ISK)

    • 24th Imperial Crusade store: 150,000 LP + 375,000,000 ISK (from 60,000 LP + 150,000,000 ISK)

  • All existing Imperial Navy Stasis Webifiers have been updated to a ‘Compact Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier’ variant:

    • This applies to both existing modules and blueprint copies.

    • The module attributes for the ‘Compact Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier’ have been changed as follows:

      • Optimal Range: 12,000m (from 15,000m)

      • Maximum Velocity Bonus: -60% (from -55%)

      • CPU usage: 16tf (from 25tf)

  • Two Compact Imperial Navy Stasis Webifiers can be swapped for a single standard version within Amarr Navy and Militia LP stores.

  • Both the Compact and standard Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier variants are now eligible for Mutaplasmids.

The original Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier was simply too strong for its price point, even after the adjustments made last week. The meta impact of very cheap, 15km webs, is significant and not something we're comfortable with. We still want the Amarr Navy and Imperial Crusade LP to have good offerings, but don't want to completely disrupt the overall web economy in the process. To address this issue, all existing Imperial Navy webs have been changed to a 'Compact' variant with their ranges nerfed to 12km. However, so as not to completely penalize those who have invested their LP, two of those webs can be traded in to receive the Imperial Navy Stasis Web with the 15km range.

Defect Fixes

Literally Unplayable:

  • Several typos and grammatical errors have been ganked. The remaining ones are Easter eggs and totally not intentional.

  • Fixed a typo in the Notification Settings, where “New Mail Received” was misspelled. In our defense, 'i' before 'e' except after 'c' doesn't exist in Icelandic.

  • “ESS Inventory Full” in the Notification Settings now uses the same capitalization as the other ESS notifications.

  • The “Chosen Executor” column header on the Members subtab of the Alliances tab in the Corporation window is now capitalized.

  • Removed the full stop at the end of the Share button tooltip in the Item Filter window.

  • Removed the full stop at the end of the tip shown in the Region tab of the Personal Assets window when you have no assets in a region.

  • The “Force Fade from Black” shortcut name in the Shortcuts menu now uses title case.

  • The “Join Fleet” button now uses title case.

  • “InterBus” is now formatted correctly in the InterBus Shuttle description.

  • Fixed the wording in the SKINR Sequencer Reward description.

  • The wording of “The ‘Fendahlian Collective’” is now consistent between the Focused Warp Disruption Script and Focused Warp Scrambling Script descriptions.

  • Removed double spaces from the Metropolis region description.

  • Fixed a double space and a missing full stop in the notifications for completed and expired HyperNet offers. The expired offer notification also now correctly says “Ticket prices have been refunded”.

Gameplay

  • Following the destruction of a player owned Tatara in Amamake on 5 November, some items didn't properly trigger into Asset Safety. Any affected items which were 'stuck' will now correctly flow through Asset Safety as normal.

Patch Notes for 2026-11-17.1

Features & Changes:

Balancing:

  • Slightly reworked how the new ‘Vigilant’ Vital Aberrant Modules function, as their strengths weren't immediately clear. Their active ability now increases their passive effect by 3x. This will retain a similar power level, though add more clarity and consistency about their bonuses.

For Example, the 'Vigilant' Vital Overdrive Injector System gives an 8% passive bonus to maximum velocity, and used to have an active effect which granted an additional 15% bonus to maximum velocity while active. These two bonuses compounded together to provide a 24.2%* Bonus to speed while activated.

Now the active effect will instead just multiply the 8% passive effect by 3x to be 24% while it is active. This will hopefully make it more clear how powerful these modules are, and should make it more powerful when fitting multiple modules which effect the same stat by having one stacking penalized bonus instead of two.

*subject to stacking penalties

Factional Warfare:

  • Added 29 new achievements, along with 29 new titles, for Factional Warfare and Insurgencies.

    • Defending Factional Warfare Complexes for a specific Empire Faction.

    • Getting the final blow on capsuleers of enemy militias while enlisted for one of the empire or insurgency factions.

    • Destroying the Factional Warfare Officer Battleship NPCs in Rendezvous points

    • Destroying special roaming enforcer or pirate NPCs in Insurgencies, like Zohar’s Chosen, Hakuzosu’s Steelscale, & various Bulwark Consortium NPCs

    • Boarding unique navy ships for the Empire Factions, and boarding pirate ships for the insurgency factions.

    • Earning Loyalty Points for Factional Warfare and Insurgency Militia corporations.

Military Campaigns:

  • 🤝Significantly increased the amount of campaign turn-in items being dropped from all forms of military campaign content. The following sites will drop more campaign items:

    • Factional Warfare Complex NPCs now drop significantly more strategic intel items.

    • The Expedition wrecks in the Ambushed Expedition site now drop significantly more items when salvaged.

    • SARO Black Site Boss NPCs and hacking containers now drop significantly more campaign items.

    • Collapsed Drifter Caches and Rogue Fabricated Caches now drop significantly more campaign items.

    • X-Grade campaign ore Aberrant material reprocess amount increased from 10 to 90.

    • Z-Grade Campaign ore Aberrant material reprocess amount increased from 25 to 225.

    • The Item Trader turn-in recipes have been adjusted.

    • The rewards from the campaign objectives per item are unchanged, so each campaign will earn more ISK and LP!

  • Significantly increased the number of sites available for the Military Campaigns

    • The number of Ambushed Expedition sites in highsec and lowsec has been increased, with a greater increase in Bulwark systems and FW Frontline systems.

    • SARO Black Sites now spawn 5 to 7 combat and exploration sites rather than 3 to 5 sites.

    • The amount of Fabricated Drone Cache and Collapsed Drifter Cache sites in highsec and lowsec has been increased, with a more significant increase in Class 1 to Class 3 wormhole systems.

    • All frontline systems now contain the lowsec variation of the campaign mining sites, rather than approximately half of frontlines before.

    • All sites have improved respawn times.

  • Reduced the volume of all campaign turn-in items by 10 to account for the new drop rate increase so they're easier to transport.

  • Removed the Sleeper Relic items from the loot drop pools from the high-tier containers in the exploration sites. They have been replaced by the potential to drop higher-value covert research tools instead, to keep the sites just as valuable but make the loot lower-volume.

  • The asteroid in the Collapsed Drifter Cache site is now much smaller and should not decloak players unless they touch it.

User Interface:

  • Improved the responsiveness of the remaining ammunition number on modules in the new HUD feature preview

  • Updated the autopilot button in the new HUD feature preview to match the rest of the buttons

  • The AIR Academy Ships window now closes automatically on undock.

  • Moved the Memberships tab in the Character Window to preserve the previous order of tabs.

Defect Fixes

Localization:

  • Fixed Chinese translations for ship, fighter, drone, module, item, skill, location and faction names and descriptions, as well as campaign text and interface messages.

User Interface & New HUD:

  • Fixed an issue that sometimes caused module HUD icons to be left in the “on” position after jumping through gates or wormholes while the module was active.

  • Swapped the Tactical Destroyer mode buttons order in the new HUD to match their order in the classic HUD (From top to bottom: Defense, Sharpshooter, Propulsion)

  • Fixed an issue that could rarely cause the AIR Academy Ships window to break if a video file failed to load properly.

Patch Notes for 2026-11-13.1

Defect Fixes:

Gameplay:

  • Corrected the price of the new Imperial Navy modules, while also adding them to the Amarr Navy stores

    • Price for the Navy Stores:

      • Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier Blueprint - 110,000 LP & 150,000,000 ISK

      • Imperial Navy Warp Scrambler Blueprint - 350,000 LP & 120,000,000 ISK

      • Imperial Navy Warp Disruptor Blueprint - 350,000 LP & 120,000,000 ISK

    • Price for the 24th Imperial Crusade store:

      • Imperial Navy Stasis Webifier Blueprint - 60,000 LP & 150,000,000 ISK

      • Imperial Navy Warp Scrambler Blueprint - 240,000 LP & 120,000,000 ISK

      • Imperial Navy Warp Disruptor Blueprint - 240,000 LP & 120,000,000 ISK

  • The Syndicate

    • New syndicate offers that had been misplaced are now correctly available in the State Protectorate Store.

Patch Notes for 2026-11-12.1

Defect Fixes:

Gameplay:

  • Fixed an issue that prevented the Academy Data Analyzer and Academy Relic Analyzer modules from working correctly.

  • Fixed the incorrect description of the Naga, which was using the description of the new Naga Navy Issue.

  • Fixed an issue preventing the new Navy Battlecruiser skins from being sold on the market

User Interface:

  • Fixed an issue that could cause the HUD to disappear when players log off and switch characters within the client while undocked.

  • Added a missing tooltip for the Membership tab in the Character sheet.

Localization:

  • Missing Chinese localization has been added for various Navy Destroyer show info pages.

  • Chinese localization for “Powergrid” has been corrected on the Navy Issue Battlecruisers and the Akoman.

  • Chinese localization on various blueprint names has been updated.

  • A number of spelling mistakes were fixed

Patch Notes for 2026-11-11.1

Features & Changes

Factional Warfare:

  • It’s now possible to remote repair Supply Depots and Supply Caches in Factional Warfare.

Graphics:

  • Academy Ship now has videos/animations that loop when you hover over each category.

Localization:

  • Added French localization to AIR Academy Ships

Miscellaneous:

  • Item Traders for Crimson Harvest have packed up shop and are no longer available.

Missions & NPCs:

  • The mission items “Crates of Synthetic Oil”, “Civilians”, and “Ship’s Crew” have had their volumes reduced. (Please don't store all of these together; it gets real messy.)

  • The mission sites for the level 1 missions “Augumene Allergen (5 of 5)”, “Athran Exigency (1 of 5)”, and “Interstellar Railroad (1 of 4)” have received a facelift and decluttering

User Interface:

  • Long achievement checklists, such as "Head of the Class", now show in a compact two-column layout that fits on screen, and each entry can be clicked to open that achievement.

Achievements:

  • The Manufacture Frigate Achievement now grants the correct item as a reward.

  • The Project Discovery Achievement now grants the correct amount of probes.

Defect Fixes:

Gameplay:

  • The Vengeance incorrectly had its rate of fire bonus to rockets swapped with a different value, leading to an unintended nerf. This has been corrected.

  • The Medium Republic Fleet Synchronizer Blueprint unintentionally required a T2 salvage component (Trigger Unit) instead of the correct T1 salvage component (Smashed Trigger Unit), this has been corrected. Smashing.

  • The ‘Deliver Aberrant Raspite’ campaign turn-in for Amarr unintentionally also gave players a booster crate in addition to the trade token, which has now been adjusted.

  • Fixed an issue that could cause the tutorial for AIR Academy ships to appear while the player is outside Exordium.

Graphics:

  • The Oracle Navy Issue was using the regular T1 Oracle Hull with a navy SKIN; the Oracle has now been correctly given its own unique extended model.

Localization:

  • Fixed the description of ‘Aberrant Raspite’ missing some text.

  • Fixed the description of some SARO Black Site combat NPCs found in the Saro Lockup having incorrect descriptions.

  • Fixed State Directive - Unlimited SKINR component being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed Deimos Presidential Agent SKIN being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed Dragoon Navy Issue Corporation Emblem being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed Imperial Navy Reserve Supply Package being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed Supplies: Battle of Pator being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed Cradle of Freedom - Unlimited SKINR component being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed "HoR Crow" Faction Warfare NPC Frigate being unintentionally renamed.

  • Fixed the description of the Tornado Fleet Issue having a typo and incorrect capitalization.

  • Fixed the Oracle Navy Issue blueprint having a trailing whitespace in the name.

  • Fixed the Aura section title missing from AIR Daily Goals in the Opportunities window.

User Interface:

  • While the New HUD feature preview is active, the Mining Surveyor button icon now correctly changes upon activation or deactivation of the Mining Foreman Burst modules.

  • While the New HUD feature preview is active, the ship's damage status, module overheat damage status, and the module cooldown colors are now adjusted correctly in colorblind mode.

  • While the New HUD feature preview is active, pressing Shift no longer activates the Overheat mode if a text field is selected (such as chat).

  • Corrected minor UI layout issues with the AIR Academy Ships window while the UI scaling is set to 90%

  • Fixed a missing label for the Aura Assistance Panel in the Opportunities window,

Patch Notes for 2026-11-10.1

The Fractured Skies expansion is out!

Full overview of the contents of the expansion can be found here: Fractured Skies Expansion notes!

Celebrate your chosen Empire with these unique items.

Each pack can be bought once per account. The SKINs and Pilot Expert Systems can be traded on the in-game market, so anything you don't need can be sold for ISK.

item.title: The Fractured Skies Expansion Is Here
item.description:
Capsuleers,

Fractured Skies has arrived, and capsuleers are ready to take on an integral part in the empires’ race toward war and destruction. Rally your forces and fleet up for the carnage ahead.

After the recent incident in Azdaja Redoubt, new evidence suggests an Emergent Artifact will soon appear in New Eden. When and where remains unknown. The empires launch new Military Campaigns, and call on all capsuleers to aid them in getting to the artifact first.

Capsuleers can take four new navy attack battlecruisers into battle and maximize their firepower with powerful new synchronizer rigs. New pilots can quickly get up to speed with free, pre-fitted AIR Academy ships in Starter Space. The future of warfare also calls for a new HUD, and warclones in EVE Vanguard permanently join the fight around the clock.

Get the upper hand with daily gifts, and to make the most of Fractured Skies, don’t forget to grab 25 PLEX and seven days of Omega for free in the New Eden Store (NES), or any of the other bargains available.

Get your fleet together, choose your side, and blaze a path to conquest in a new era of warfare. This is only the beginning.

The Race for the Artifact

In their fervor to claim the Emergent Artifact, each empire has launched a new Military Campaign. They call on capsuleers to gather items that advance Drifter tech research, helping them locate the artifact first and secure an edge in the conflict ahead.

Anyone can join, from veteran fleet commanders to new pilots – no enlistment needed.

Hack containers, destroy enemy forces in Factional Warfare complexes and new campaign sites, and mine ore to gather items that push your empire's objectives forward. Deliver the campaign items you get to the item traders in your empire's headquarters system for ISK, Loyalty Points (LP), and trader offers, and earn new achievements, titles, and Penumbral SKINs along the way.

Every objective completed unlocks system-wide bonuses in that faction’s space, such as faster warp speed, stronger defenses, or extra damage. These activate early January.

In mid-January, the Emergent Artifact is expected to surface, and the empires will face off in an unprecedented four-way brawl. The location of the brawl will be determined by the first empire to complete all four campaign objectives. Furthermore, that empire also brings command carrier reinforcements led by a faction general, and gets a limited-time Drifter module in its LP store. In addition, the bonuses it has unlocked during the campaign will be active on that battlefield.

Every campaign completed, fleet assembled and advantage earned will help shape the coming conflict.

The last campaigns have now changed New Eden for good. The Minmatar renamed Arzad II to Starkman Prime, the Gallente and Caldari opened new stargates, and the Amarr established the Deaconry of Economic Oversight. Now, the stakes are higher.

Bring More Firepower

Fly the first navy attack battlecruisers into battle as the empires bolster their arsenals, available only from Factional Warfare LP stores:

Naga Navy Issue: Trades its hybrid turrets for cruise missile and torpedo launchers, and gains an extra mid slot.

Tornado Fleet Issue: Fires its large projectiles faster, gains an extra mid slot, and takes a smaller signature penalty under microwarpdrive.

Oracle Navy Issue: Reaches further, with an extra low slot and a utility high slot.

Talos Navy Issue: Moves faster under armor plates, gains an extra low slot, and turns its blaster tracking bonus into falloff.

Synchronizer rigs also join the arsenal. These new rigs reward loyalty and grow stronger with every matching faction module you fit. They come in nine sets and three sizes: one for each empire and one for each of five pirate factions. The pirate sets offer bonuses no other rig can, but with tradeoffs.

EVE Vanguard Connects

The war also moves to the ground, permanently.

Warclones take the fight to the planets, and the connection to EVE Online is now always on: every contract and expedition completed by Warclones increases the number of special campaign sites appearing in highsec and lowsec space.

The security levels of space are mirrored with highsec, lowsec, and nullsec maps on the ground, and there is a new narrative-driven tutorial, teaching you the ropes and immersing you in the lore of the Vanguard.

Join the paid alpha to play EVE Vanguard 24/7 through the EVE launcher. Blast your way through three new maps, brandish the Gallente BR-60 Battle Rifle, try out Weapon Telemetry progression, and much more.

You’ll find all the details about the EVE Vanguard alpha and road to Early Access on the EVE Vanguard website.

Build Your Ranks

New pilots now have more ways to get ready to join the war:

AIR Academy ships: 13 free, pre-fitted ships for combat, exploration, and mining in Starter Space. Swap between them at any station in Exordium and find out what you enjoy before spending a single ISK.

AIR Career Program: Now part of Achievements, with almost 80 achievements to complete and a title for each career and for finishing the full program.

Level-one missions: A visual overhaul, a cleaner overview, and mission objects that show up when you need them.

Got a friend who has always wanted to try EVE Online? There has never been a better time to bring them along.

A New Way to Fly

Enter the future and pilot your ships in a new way, as the first phase of the new HUD is rolled out in opt-in Feature Preview. Shield, armor, and hull now sit around your capacitor, a new gauge shows your energy gain and loss at a glance, heat indicators sit beside their racks, and active modules are easier to read. Try it out and give your feedback!

And Much More

Fractured Skies also brings a variety of new achievements and titles, balance changes to ships including the Sacrilege, Cerberus, Vengeance, Legion, Proteus, and Tengu, better defender missiles, slower void bombs, improved fleet tools, and a variety of Little Things based on player feedback.

For a quick overview on everything in the expansion, check out the In Focus video, or dive into the expansion notes for all the details.

Daily Gifts

Hit the expansion at warp speed with daily gifts, including up to 800,000 SP, Quafe Zero boosters, 17 new SKINR components, and four empire character backgrounds. Show the cluster where your loyalty lies with empire emblem patterns and new colors for your ships, or decorate in a grand way with the palm tree and colorful sunrise patterns. The first round of daily gifts runs until 24.Nov and a second round to celebrate Black Friday begins on 27.Nov. Don't miss a day!

Seven Days of Omega for Free

Until 20 November, you can claim seven days of Omega for free in the NES to explore everything Fractured Skies has to offer.

Bring your alts, too! The offer can be claimed once per account, on up to three accounts per email address: your main and two alts, as described in the EVE Academy alt accounts guide. This is a one-off for this offer, so there is no need to move accounts between emails.

A Gift with Your Gift

Your weekly 15,000 Skill Points (SP) gift in the New Eden Store (NES) comes with something extra this week. To celebrate the launch of Fractured Skies, Omega pilots can also claim 25 PLEX for free, as a thank-you for flying Omega. The gift can be claimed once per account until 10:59 UTC on 17 November.

Expansion Offers

Each empire has a Campaign Pack in the EVE Store, where you get a value of $60 but pay only $30. Every pack contains 500 PLEX, 648,000 SP, a Genius 'Boost' Cerebral Accelerator, the empire's new navy battlecruiser SKIN, its Pilot Expert System, and an older SKIN from its line. Each pack can be bought once per account and is available until 23:59 UTC on 4 December.

And save up to 25% on one, three, and six months of Omega in the NES until 20 November. Omega packs with up to 1,500 free PLEX are also available in the EVE Store until 26 November.

The Path to Conquest

The empires have been building devastating Conquest Engines, capable of asserting control over entire star systems within the Factional Warfare warzones. For now, a peace brokered by CONCORD holds between them, but as tensions rise over the next several weeks, fractures are expected to appear. When the pact breaks, Factional Warfare changes.

The race for the artifact ends in January, when all four empires clash in lowsec and call on all capsuleers to join the fight. At the end of the battle, Conquest Engines are expected to be deployed, and in February, the first Conquest begins. At that time, every capsuleer can start building conquest power for their empire and fight over directives. The conflict will come to a head as the winner of each Conquest will be determined in a Siege between rival empires, where one Conquest Engine must fall.

Until then, it is vital to mobilize and prepare. Every campaign completed, fleet assembled and advantage earned will help shape the coming conflict. Will you show up, or be blown up?

Fly safe, capsuleers.
